# @stylexjs/eslint-plugin

`index.mjs` bundles `@stylexjs/eslint-plugin@0.19.1` (MIT). Licenses:
[StyleX](LICENSE), [dependencies](licenses/).

To update, install the desired version in `packages/lint`, then run:

```sh
bun build packages/lint/node_modules/@stylexjs/eslint-plugin/lib/index.js --bundle --minify --target=node --format=esm --outfile=packages/lint/vendor/stylex/index.mjs
```
